(469)'od gsal snying gi thig le las:sgrol ma rigs lnga'i phrin las kyi khog dbub rin chen gter bum bzhugs/(470)na mo ārya tā re yi/ma skyes pas

tei:div.tei:p: (469)'od gsal snying gi thig le las: sgrol ma rigs lnga'i phrin las kyi khog dbub rin chen gter bum bzhugs/ (470)

na mo ārya tā re yi/ ma skyes pas na mi 'gags shing*/ dri med 'phel 'grib bral ba ste/ de phyir chos rnams kun gyi dbyings/ sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ ma 'ongs dus kyi snyigs ma la/ 'gro ba las dang nyon mongs pas/ sna tshogs sdug bsngal gzir ba la/ phan phyir las kyi phrin las bsdebs/ de yang zla ba rgyas pa yar ngo'i dus su/ dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa'i stegs bur rin chen lnga dang 'bru sman dang*/ me tog ser po'i rigs kyi ril lu nyi shu rtsa gcig bhi waṃ dang dri bzang gi na bza' gsol zhing*/ rin po che'i ga 'ur 'khor lo dang bcas pa bcug ste/ mthar phying gi mchod pa dang me tog ser po'i rigs mang du bshams/ phrin las la 'jug (471) tshul/ byor dngos rjes gsum gyi dang po la/ thog mar bgegs bsal ba ni/ oṃ/ rang bzhin mnyam pa chen po las/ skad cig sprul pa'i cho 'phrul bzhin/ sgrol ma ku ru kulle ma/ pha rol sde dang stobs 'joms pa/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin la/ snyoms par zhugs pas rab bskul bas/ sa rnams rnam drug rab g.yos shing*/ khro mo zhing gi rdul snyed spros/ srid pa 'di na su ya rung*/ gdug cing gtum pa'i sems 'chang ba/ thams cad stong pa chen por sbyangs/ rga oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re rga hūm̐ phaṭaḥ dang hūm̐ bzhes yungs thun brab/ oṃ/ sprul (472)pa ye shes sgyu ma las/ utpal rdo rje spel ma'i gyur/ rnam lnga 'bar ba'i tshwa tshwa 'phros/ gsang ba mtshams kyi 'khor lor gsal/ oṃ badzra dzwa la badzra ta na hūm̐ phaṭaḥ de nas skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ oṃ/ deng nas bla med byang chub bar/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas kun gyi gtso/ rnam bzhi'i 'phags pa bskyed pa'i yum/ rje btsun sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ 'gro ba kun la phan slad du/ yang dag nyid du skyabs su mchi/ sems bskyed pa ni/ aḥ skye rga na 'chi sdug bsngal gyi/ srid pa'i chu bor 'khyams pa rnams/ rang bzhin skye ba med pa'i dbyings/

sangs rgyas sa la 'god par bya/ tshogs bsags pa ni/ oṃ/ sras bcas 'phags ma'i spyan snga ru/ sgo gsum dang bas phyag 'tshal lo/ kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung 'bul/ thog med nyes (473)byas mthol lo bshags/ byang chub spyod la rjes yi rang*/ zag med chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ 'gro mgon mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs/ yang dag sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo/ brda sgo dbye zhing gnyis su med par phyag 'tshal ba ni/ oṃ/ sems nyid ye nas 'od gsal ba/ rnam thar gsum ldan rje btsun ma/ ye nas rang dang gnyis med kyang*/ gam na bzhugs pa zhal ma mtsho/ rgyangs mar 'tsho la bas thang re chad/ da ni rang byung rig pa'i gshis/ mngon sum lta bas phyag 'tshal lo/ nyes byas 'gyod bshags bya ba ni/ a/ ma rig kun rtog gzhan dbang gis/ thog med dus nas da lta'i bar/ sangs rgyas mnyes par mi 'gyur ba'i/ sdig ltung dri ma mthol zhing bshags/ yi ge brgya pa brjod/ bdag nas yo byad la byin dbab pa ni/ oṃ/ (474)phyogs bcu'i zhing na bzhugs pa yi/ bde gshegs rgyal ba sras dang bcas/ lha dang mkha' 'gro dam tshan rnams/ sngon gyi thugs dam chen po bzhin/ mkha' la sprin ltar gtibs nas kyang*/ rnal 'byor bdag cag sgrub pa po/ sku gsum thugs kyis byin gyis rlobs/ rnam bzhi mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ rtsa sngags dang*/ ā be sha ya sa ma ya jaḥjaḥpheṃ pheṃ/ de nas dam bca' ba ni/ oṃ/ ye nas gsang chen nges pa'i bka'/ dam tshig sdom pa la gnas shing*/ lha yi 'khor lo dag dang ldan/ srog chags rnams ni bsad mi bya/ ma byin pa yang mi blang zhing*/ bud med mi bsten smad mi bya/ rdzun ni rnam pa kun tu spangs/ myos 'gyur dag dang sha rnams spangs/ mo rnams sems can kun la yang*/ chags pa'i sems (475)ni kun spangs te/ ma bzhin du ni kun lani/ phan pa'i sems kyis bkur byas nas/ dam tshig sdom pa la gnas pas/ las rnams kun la mthu yod bya/ mchod rdzas byin brlab ni/

oṃ/ rnam par mi rtog ngang nyid las/ yid bzhin rin chen 'byung ba'i gter/ kun bzang mchod pa rnam mang pos/ zhing rnams rgyas par 'gengs par gyur/ puṣpe nas shapda 'i bar dang ma hā pañtsa amṛ ta rakta ba liṃ ta sarba pū ja hoḥ dang nam mkha' mdzad kyi sngags rgyas spel ba'o/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i chos la/ de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'jin ni/ oṃ/ sems nyid rang bzhin skye ba med/ rnam par mi rtog rtog las 'das/ chos rnams mnyam pa chen po'i dbyings/ de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'jin bsgom/ oṃ dharma dhartu (476)bi shuddhe hūm̐ḥ snying rje sgyu ma ni/ āḥ skye ba rnam bzhis bsdus pa yi/ ma rtogs log pa'i sems can rnams/ rang snang 'khrul bas rang bcings pa/ sangs rgyas sa la 'god par bya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā sa ma yi āḥ rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ hūm̐ḥ skye med ngang las snying rje'i gdangs/ 'gags med cir yang 'char ba las/ rang byung rig pa yi ge tām̐/ gser zhun lugs su blugs pa bzhin/ sra zhing 'thas la mi shigs pa/ mi phyed rdo rje'i chos bdun bsgom/ dzñā na badzra tsitta sa ma yi āḥ de las dbyings kyi yi ge lnga/ mkha' la 'ja' tshon shar ba bzhin/ 'phros pas snod bcud zhen rtog sbyangs/ yum lnga'i mkha' klong rnam par dag oṃ eḥyam̐ lam̐ sam̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭaḥ dharmā dhā tu sa manta pañtsa (477)kṣa bu tha na na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā maṇḍal bi shuddhe sam̐ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ bhrūm̐ las 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas/ sprul pa'i zhing khams po ta la/ sna tshogs nor bu'i gzhal med khang*/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid rdzogs/ 'dod snam pha gu rin chen phreng*/ mda' phab shar bu mjes pa'i tog sgo rgyan rgyu 'bras rta bab ldan/ drwa ba drwa phyed 'phyang 'phrul dang*/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan brgyan/ 'dod yon mchod sprin bsam mi khyab/ nang khyams gru chad glo bur bcas/ lte bar padma 'dab ma bzhi/ khyams sgor phyogs bzhir pad zla re/

sam̐ padma maṇḍal/ a tsant+ra maṇḍal/ rang bzhin rtsa ba'i yi ge tām̐/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du babs/ gser zhun lta bu'i tām̐ yig (478)las/ utpal tām̐ gyis mtshan pa las/ srid pa dag ni thams cad du/ sna tshogs 'od dang zer gyis khengs/ sprul pa sgyu ma 'ja' tshon dang*/ smig rgyu chu zla gzugs brnyan bzhin/ 'jig rten bdun po snang byas nas/ snang zhing srid pa'i chos so cig ye nas dag mnyam chen po'i ngang*/ snod bcud lha yi rol par shar/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rin chen rigs las skyes pa yi/ brtson 'grus shugasad nga ldan pa'i yum/ sgrol ma bsod nams mchog ster ma/ jam bu'i nā da'i kha dog la/ ston ka'i zla ba rgyas pa ltar/ dag cing gtsang la dri ma med/ gzhon nu lang tsho dar la bab/ zhi zhing 'jum pa'i mdangs dang ldan/ thugs rjes rjes su chags pa yi/ smin legs spyan ni (479)rnam par 'khyug ka sha'i ras kyi stod g.yogs dang*/ pañtsa'i gos kyis smad dkris sing*/ rin chen thor tshugs do shal dang*/ rna cha gtsub kor 'og par sogs/ sna tshogs rgyan gyis mjes par spras/ 'od dpag med kyi cod pan 'chang*/ g.yas pas mchog sbyin phyag rgya mjad/ g.yon pa dkon cog gsum mtshon rgyas/ sdong bu dang bcas utpa la/ rin chen bum pas mtshan pa bsnams/ zhabs gnyis skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs/ padma rgyas pa'i ze'u 'bru'i steng*/ zla ba rgyas pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ bye ba phrag brgya'i 'od kyi tshogs/ sku las 'phros pa de nyid las/ bdud rtsi'i zegs ma 'phro ba'i steng*/ 'byung po'i stobs rnams zil gnon pa'i/ byang chub sems dpa'i (480)dpag med gsal/ shar gyi padma'i 'dab ma'i steng*/ rang nyid sgrol ma'i thugs ka nas/ phyag mtshan bon tām̐ bcas pa/ tshon chen lnga yi kha dog gi 'od zer chen po'i snang ba ni/ sprul pa ye shes sgyu ma las/ 'jig rten bdunan po gang byas te/ snod bcud rgyud rnams dag byas nas/

kun kyang lha yi rol par shar/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ sgrol lam sngo bsang nam mkha'i mdog g.yas pas tri shul thugs kar 'dzin/ g.yon pas utpal sngon po bsnams/ sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis spros/ mthong bas yid 'phrog tā re ma/ padma rgyas pa'i ze'u 'bru la/ zla ba rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor steng*/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs/ lha phyogs 'dab ma ser po'i steng*/ rang nyid sgrol ma'i thugs ka nas/ phyag mtshan sa bon (481)re bcas pa/ tshon chen lnga/ 'od zer chen/ dbang po'i gzhu dang smig rgyu bzhin/ 'jig rten bdun/ snod bcud rgyud/ kun kyang lha yi/ tshur 'dus yongs su/ sgrol lam gser gyi kha dog can/ g.yas pas ral gri thugs kar 'dzin/ g.yon pas utpal ser po bsnams/ rgyan dang cha lugs gtso mo bzhin/ tshogs gnyis rgyas byed tā re ma/ padma rgyas pa las byung ba'i/ zla ba rgyas pa'i gdan gyi steng*/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs/ nub phyogs 'dab ma dmar po'i steng*/ rang nyid sgrol ma'i thugs ka nas/ phyag mtshan sa bon tu bcas pa/ tshon chen lnga/ 'od zer chen/ chu zla gzugs brnyan cho 'phrul gyis/ 'jig rten bdun/ snod bcud rgyud/ kun kyang lha yi/ slar 'dus yongs/ sgrol ma'i 'jig rten (482)dbang byed ma/ bandhu ji wa ka yi mdog g.yas pas 'khor lo thugs kar 'jin/ g.yon pas utpa dmar po bsnams/ rgyan dang cha lugs gtso mo bzhin/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i skyil krung gis/ padma rgyas pa/ zlal ba rgyas pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ byang phyogs 'dab ma ljang gu'i steng*/ rang nyid sgrol ma'i thugs ka nas/ phyag mtshan sa bon tām̐ bcas pa/ tshon chen lnga yi/ 'od zer chen/ rten 'brel sgyu ma'i snang ba yis/ 'jig rten bdun/ snod bcud rgyud/ kun kyang lha yi/ tshur 'dus yongs su/ sgrol ma sna tshogs las byed ma/ mar gad dri ma med pa'i mdog g.yas pas gdugs dkar thugs kar 'dzin/

g.yon pas utpal ljang gu bsnams/ rgyan dang cha lugs gtso mo bzhin/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stangs stabs kyis/ pad rgyas pa'i (483)zla ba rgyas pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ kun kyang lang tsho dar la bab/ mtshan dpe 'od kyi phung por 'bar/ sems can don la brtson shugs ldan/ bud med sgyu ma'i snyoms 'chang zhing*/ thugs rje chags pa'i spyan 'khyug cing*/ ma rnams ma 'jigs ma 'jigs zhes/ dbugs 'byin chen po sbyin par mdzad/ dkyil 'khor phyogs kyi sgo bzhi ru/ rang nyid sgrol ma'i thugs ka nas/ sa bon ta se ru re bzhi/ 'jig rten gsum du spros byas pas/ sa chen rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od kyis gang*/ lha dang lha min nam mkha' lding*/ mi 'am ci dang dri za'i tshogs/ lto 'phyo srin po 'byung ngo rnams/ tshar bcad stobs 'brog dpa' bkongs nas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ shar sgor sgrol lam lcags kyu dkar/ phyag gnyis lcags kyu thugs kar 'dzin/ lho sgor (484)sgrol lam zhags pa ser/ phyag gnyis thugs kar zhags pa 'dzin/ nub sgor sgrol lam lcags sgrog dmar/ phyag gnyis thugs kar lcags sgrog 'dzin/ byang sgor sgrol lam dril bu ljang*/ phyag gnyis thugs kar dril bu 'dzin/ rgyan dang cha lugs gtso mo bzhin/ kun kyang drang srong khros pa'i nyams/ spyan zla mche ba rnam par gtsigs/ dmar ser ral pa gyen du phyogs/ zhabs gnyis rta bab skyil krung gis/ padma rgyas pa'i/ zla ba rgyas pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ lha rnams spyan mgrin thugs ka ru/ rgyal ba rnams kyi sku gsung thugs/ 'bru gsum ye shes srog dang bcas/ ye shes lnga bdag cod pan 'chang*/ gsal stong lhun grub chen por bsgom/ phyi rol zhing gi bkod pa ni/ padma drwa ba can gyi zhing*/ sna tshogs khams kyis rnam par spros/ sgrib pa mi mnga' mngon sum du/ rin chen lnga (485)yis rab mjes pa/ yan lag brgyad ldan byug pa yi/ mtsho dang mtsho phran rjing bu'i tshogs/

nor bu sna tshogs bye bas gtams/ mdzes pa'i me tog kun nas bskor/ dga' zhing 'phyo la lding ba'i bya/ snyan pa'i skad 'byin chos sgra sgrogs/ rin chen gling na lhun po dang*/ dag pa'i zhing na dag pa'i rdzas/ pi waṃ gling bu rja rnga dang*/ sil snyan glu gar bstod dbyangs kyi/ lha dang lha mo bsam mi khyab/ ta la dpag bsam ljon pa'i tshal/ dar dang rin chen 'phyang 'phrul dang*/ me tog 'bras bu rnam par smin/ phyogs bzhir dar gyi ba dan las/ spos kyi dri zhim rgyas par 'gengs/ nam mkhar ratna sna tshogs pa'i/ sprin tshog stug po las skyes pa'i/ spos chu me tog 'dres pa dang*/ 'dod yon (486)sna tshogs char chen 'bebs/ gser gyi bya skyibs brag ri'i khrod/ spang ljang me tog brgyan pa'i tshal/ smin pa'i glang chen stong dag dang*/ rta mchog yid bzhin 'dod 'jo'i ba/ ri dwags tshogs ni dal gyis rgyu/ grub pa'i rig 'dzin bye ba brgya/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug chen po dang*/ rig sngags rgyal mo stong phrag gis/ rtag tu zhi ba brten pa'i gnas/ snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor chen por gsal/ spyan dreng ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang rtsa ba'i tām̐ yig las 'od zer ser po lcags kyu'i dbyings can phyogs dang phyogs mtshams thams cad du 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad kyi thugs dam bskul/ thugs rje dang byin rlabs thams cad rje btsun ma'i rnam par bzhengs nas/ dam tshig (486)pa rnams la sib kyis thim par dmigs nas/ oṃ/ skyob pa 'od dpag med pa yi/ thugs dam chen po'i dkyil 'akor nas/ smon lam stobs las 'khrungs pa'i sku/ sgrol ma'i mtshan gyi rnga chen po/ zhing rnams kun tu rab grags ma/ rje btsun sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas/ dam tshig chen po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ thugs rje'i dbang gis 'byon par 'tshal/ nyon mongs dri ma bsal ba dang*/

sdug bsngal thams cad sel byed cing*/ sems can rnams la sman slad du/ 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ārya tā re sa pa ri wā ra e hya hi ma hā ka ru ṇi ka sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya st+waṃ jaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ bzhugs su gsaul ba ni/ oṃ/ nyi ma zla ba rgyas 'dar ba'i/ gzhon (488)nu'i sku la 'gying bag can/ sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i yum/ sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ utpal sngon po'i ge sar la/ nya gang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng*/ dgyes mnyam mchog gi thugs ldan pas/ gnyis su med par bzhugs su gsol/ padma tsant+ra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ las dang nyon mongs stobs rnams dang*/ bdud kyi sde rnams pham mdzad ma/ skyob pa skyabs 'os bde ba sbyin/ shes bcu rnam dag rjogs sangs rgyas/ dbyangs can lha mo spyan yangs ma/ shes rab blo 'phel snyan pa che/ g.yul las sgrol phyed rgyal ba mo/ sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ a ti pu hoḥ pra titstsha hoḥ de nas mchod pa'i rim pa la/ nyer spyod sogs kyi mchod pa ni/ oṃ/ 'jig rten khams ni (489)rab 'byams na/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin brlabs shing*/ me tog sil ma phreng bar spel/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi char chen po/ sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing*/ las dang ye shes dngos grub stsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ārya tā re puṣpe pū ja me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ḥ oṃ/ 'jig rten khams ni/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis/ sman shing rang byung sbyar ba'i spos/ mchod pa'i/ sgrol ma/ bsod nams/ las dang*/ oṃ sarba/ dhu pe/ oṃ/ 'jig rten/ sangs rgyas/ snang la sgron me'i bye brag gi mchod pa'i/ sgrol ma/ bsod nams/ las dang*/ oṃ sarba/ ā lo ke oṃ/ 'jig rten/ sangs rgyas/ tsan dan ga bur sbyar ba'i dri/ mchod pa'i/ sgrol ma/ (490)bsod nams/ las dang*/ oṃ sarba/ gandhe/ oṃ/ 'jig rten/

sangs rgyas/ bza' btung ro brgya ldan pa yi/ mchod/ sgrol ma/ bsod nams/ las/ oṃ sarba/ nai bi tyā/ oṃ/ 'dzin/ sangs rgyas/ glu dang rol mo snyan pa'i dbyangs/ mchod/ sgrol ma/ bsod nams/ las dang*/ oṃ sarba/ shabda/ gzhan yang mchod par 'os pa'i rgyan/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan dang*/ sna tshogs gos kyi bye brag dang*/ dpag bsam rin chen ljon pa'i shing*/ dri zhim me tog 'bras bur ldan/ rgyal srid bkra shis rjas rtags brgyad/ lha dang mim yi 'jig rten na/ bdag pos bzung dang ma bzung ba'i/ 'bab chu klung dang lding ka dang*/ mtsho dang rdzing bu khrus kyi rjing*/ padma utpal drwa bas khebs/ ngang pa bzhad sogs (491)lding bas brgyan/ rin chen khang mdzos drwa ba dang*/ drwa phyed nyi zla'i snang ba can/ mchod pa'i lha mo mang po bcas/ sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ bsod nams/ las dang ye shes/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ārya tā re ma hā pū ja me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ḥ

'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa ni/ oṃ/ 'jig rten khams ni/ sangs rgyas/ gzugs kyi lha mo rdo rje ma/ me long ye shes ngo bo nyid/ gzugs mdzes gar gyi bye brag gi mchod pa'i sprin gyi/ sgrol ma/ bsod nams/ las dang*/ oṃ rū pa pra titstsha pū ja hoḥ oṃ/ 'jig rten/ sangs rgyas/ sgra yi lha mo pi waṃ ma/ mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid/ sgra snyan bstod pa'i bye brag gi mchod/ sgrol ma/ bsod nams/ (492)las dang*/ oṃ shapta pra titstsha/ oṃ/ 'jig rten/ sangs rgyas/ drwi yi lha mo zhabs bsil thogs/ sor rtog ye shes ngo bo nyid/ mchod/ sgrol ma/ bsod nams/ las/ oṃ gandhe/ oṃ/ 'jig rten/ sangs rgyas/ ro yi lha mo zhal mdzes thogs/ bya grub ye shes ngo bo nyid/ mchod/ sgrol ma/ bsod nams/ las/ oṃ rā pa/ oṃ/ 'jig rten/ sangs rgyas/ reg bya'i lha mo gos zung thogs/ chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid/ mchod/ sgrol ma/ bsod nams/ las/ oṃ sparshe pra tītstsha pū ja hūm̐ḥ nang sman raka gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/ oṃ/ 'chi med bdud rtsi ra sā yan/ nyon mongs chags pa'i rakta dang*/ blang dor gnyis med ba liṃ ta/ dgyes mnyam mchog gi mchod pa bzhes/ oṃ ma hā pañtsa amṛ ta rakta ba liṃ ta pū ja hoḥ (493) gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ hoḥ dag mnyam bden pa dbyer med la/ mchod bya mchod byed ka nas dag rang byung ye shes chen po'i ngang*/ mnyam rjogs chen po'i mchod pa bzhes/ dharma dhā tu dzñā na badzra sa ma ya hoḥ de nas bstod pa ni/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta saṃ myaksaṃ buddha ya te tre ya te tā re tu re oṃ/ aṃ/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ chos dbyings ye shes rnam par dag 'jigs pa brgyad rnams zhi bar mjod/ bde gshegs yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i thugs/ me long ye shes ngo bo nyid/ tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo ma/ rdo rje'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan rdzogs/

mnyam nyid ye shes ngang la gnas/ tshogs chen bsod nams mchog ster ma/ (494)rin chen yum la= sangs rgyas kun gyi mi shigs gsung*/ sor rtog ye shes thams cad mkhyen/ 'jig rten gsum po dbang byed ma/ padma'i yum la= sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las rdzogs/ bya grub ye shes chags thogs bral/ sna tshogs phrin las mthar phyin ma/ las kyi yum la= ljang mdzes sprin gyi gur gsob na/ sangs rgyas ma chags padma'i spyan/ gzhon nu mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar/ sgrol ma yum la= 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrugs pa'i dbus/ khro bo'i tshogs chen spro zhing sdud/ brkyang bskum stabs kyis gdug pa 'dul/ khro gnyer can la/ oṃ/ 'jig rten gsum na grags pa yi/ 'byung po gang dag ji snyed pas/ zhabs kyi padmo la btud cing*/ 'jig rten gsum mgon khyed la bstod/ sems can kun la (495)phan bzhedam/ dbang phyug lha dang lha min dang*/ rigs sngags 'chang ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ bkur 'os mchod gnas khyed la bstod/ bkra shis rnam rgyal skye dgu'i bdag rgod bdag dregs dang dri ma zhi/ padma'i spyan dang zhal mnga' ba/ gsum gtsang gtsang mar gyur la/ utpal sngon po'i zur mig gis/ rtag tu 'gro ba skyong mdzad cing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa sras bcas kyis/ sgrol ma'i mtshan gyis bsngags la/ gang zhig mtshan tsam dran pas kyang*/ de yi don kun 'grub 'gyur zhing*/ nyon mongs kun las rnam grol ba/ sangs rgyas nyid kyang thob par 'gyur/ de nas bsnyen pa bya ba ni/ aḥ thugs kar padma zla ba'i (496)steng*/ rang byung rig pa yi ge tām̐/ de mthar rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor/ 'od 'phros las bzhi'i phrin las bsgrub/ ces/ rje btsun ma'i thugs kar utpal dang zla ba'i dal gyi steng rig pa yi ge tām̐ ser po'i mthar rtsa ba'i sngags phreng gser zhun ma'i kha dog lta bu chos bskor du 'khor ba dang*/ sku'i cha thams cad nas bdud rtsi ser po'i rgyun dang*/

utpal ser po'i ze'u 'bru las/ byang chub sems dpa' gzhan gyi stobs zil gyis gnon pa mang po nyi zer gyi rdul lta bu 'phros pas/ lha dang lha min/ nam mkha' lding*/ mi'am ci/ dri za/ lto 'phyo/ srin po 'byung po'i tshogs gang su yang rung ba rnams kyi stobs dang sde rnams tsir tshar bcad nas snang la rang bzhin med par sbyangs/ slar 'dus 'jig rten gsum po thams cad rje btsun (497)ma'i sku dang*/ gsung sngags kyi sgra dbyangs thugs utpal tām̐ ser pos mtshan pa sha stag tu gyur nas bdag dang rten rnams thim pas tshe dang bsod nams ye shes yon tan thams cad gong 'phel du gyur par bsam la/ oṃ tā re tā re tuttā re swā hā/ zhes bzla ba bsnyen pa'o/ nye bsnyen rgyas pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ tā re tā re tuttā re hūm̐ ka ra su re na te pañtsa ri sabta lo ka kra ma kro ti a she ṣa su purṇaṃ ku ru kar shan kṣa mi hoḥ zhes gtso bor bzla'o/ las myur du 'grub pa'i sngags/ aṃ oṃ tā re oṃ/ oṃ tā re oṃ/ oṃ tuttā re oṃ/ zhes bzla/ de nas 'jam dpal gyi thugs dam sgrol ma'i gzungs ni/ ag khe/ bag khe na ji te/ nā ga pa te/ na he li/ ja hi li/ ja hi li ba ti/ tsa ṭī la ba te swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa bzla'o/ de nas (498) sgrol ma'i rigs sngags de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs dam gyi sngags/ arte marte/ ba ke bā ra ke be ke ṭa/ dra ma ti/ tā ra ma ti/ ṭu ta ma ṭi/ tu ṭa ma ṭi/ ṭu ṭa ma ṭi/ ṭu ṭa ṭu re/ pu re hi li mu le ti li swā hā/ zhes pa brgya stong la sogs par bzla'o/ phan yon ni/ 'byung po'i tshogs ni mtha' yas kyis/ de yi stobs thub mi 'gyur bar/ bsrung dang skyob dang sbed par byed/ dus min 'chi dang rmi lam ngan/ rims dang dug gis mi tshugs la/ longs spyod che dang bkrag stobs ldan/ rtag tu sangs rgyas mthong ba dang*/ bsod nams phun sum tshogs par 'gyur/

sa ma yāḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba/ thun min dbang gi mchod pas mnyes par byed pa la/ bza' btung tshogs kyi yo byad rgyas par bsags la/ byin brlab ni/ oṃ/ rang nyid thugs las ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ 'phros pas dngos 'jin zhen pa sbyangs/ bde skyong yangs pa'i snod kyi nang*/ mi khyi glang chen rta rma bya/ dkar rtsi (499)dmar rtsi bdud rtsir bcas/ ye nas rigs lnga ye shes lnga/ gdod nas dag pa'i dam tshig rdzas/ 'dod yon lha mo'i sprin phung bcas/ ngo mtshar zag med bdud rtsir gyur/ oṃ aḥhūm̐/ tshogs la spyan 'dren pa ni/ oṃ/ longs spyod chen po'i dkyil 'akor nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ sku gsung thugs ldan rdo rje'i bdag ma lus 'phags ma'i rnam rol gyi/ dbyer med rang bzhin dkyil 'khor nas/ tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ oṃ tā re tām̐ badzra sa ma ya jaḥjaḥ dang po phud kyi mchod pa ni/ oṃ/ bza' dang bca' dang btung dang bgo longs spyod lnga dang ldan pa yi/ sprin phung tshogs kyi mchod pa 'dis/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus mnyes/ (500)oṃ tā re tām̐ ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pū ja hoḥ bar bshags ni/ oṃ/ sgrub pa mchog gi dam tshig las/ gzung 'jin spros pa 'phel ba yis/ rnam rtog zhags pas bcings pa gang*/ nyams shing chag pa mthol lo bshags/ yi ge brgya pa brjod/ tha ma bsgral zhing bstab pa ni/ skad cig gis rang nyid sgrol ma sku mdog nag mo cung zad khros pa skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa bzhin gnyer zhing mche ba'i myu gu gtsigs pa/ g.yas gri gug dang g.yon utpal gyi steng na bram ze mi'i thod pa me tog dmar pos bkang ba 'dzin skur wal gyis gsal bar gyur/ oṃ/ 'jig rten 'di na su yang rung*/ gdug cing gtum sems 'chang ba rnams/ dgug dang bcings dang lha dang dbye/ rmongs dang bsad pa'i ting 'dzin (501)gyis/ rdo rje'i mtshon gyis btab byas te/ rdul du brlags nas tshogs su 'bul/

oṃ tā re tutta re hūm̐ swa mā ra ya ha phaṭa: ces gtubs nas/ oṃ/ sgyu ma mig yor lta bu'i tshul/ 'phrul dga'i dpal gyi longs spyod kyis/ bde gshegs rnams kyi yul du sbyor/ sems can ni thugs kyi sras su bskyed/ a mu ka ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na la kha raṃ khā hi/ lhag ma bya ba ni/ oṃ/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i mu ran la/ gnas pa'i mkha' 'gro dam tshig can/ slas dang byi mo bran mo'i tshogs/ lhag ma'i 'dod yon dam tshig bzhes/ rnam bzhi las kyi phrin las kun/ ma thogs myur du mngon du phyungs/ sa ma ya utstshiṣṭa ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hiḥ(502) thugs dam bskal ba ni/ oṃ/ sna tshogs 'jigs pa'i chu gter las/ yid can rnams ni bsgral mdzad ma/ utpal sngon po'i kha dog can/ khyed ni rdo rje 'phro ba ste/ de phyir rdo rje bdud rtsir brjod/ rdo rje 'bar ba stobs mo che/ sgyu 'phrul thugs dul dbyings nas bzhengs/ ngo mtshar chen po 'du mdzad nas/ ma rung snyigs ma'i rgyud pa sel/ byang chub sgrub la bar gcod pa'i/ mi mthun rkyen ngan tha dag zlog bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ sa ma yāḥ de nas chad mdo bsgrag pa ni/ oṃ/ stag shod mkha' 'gro'i sman chu khar/ lha cig rgya bza' kong jo yis/ rgyal sras padma las 'brel rtsal/ mngon sum rjes su bzung ba'i tshe/ stag srin zor gdong la sogs pa/ mkha' 'gro dregs pa (503)sde brgyad dang*/ ma mo brtan ma dbang phyug bcas/ ji ltar khas blangs bro bor bzhin/ rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ g.yo sgyu med cing gus ldan pas/ las kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ bro nan ni/ sangs rgyas dam tshig chen po ni/ yi ge ma yi dkyil 'khor du/ lu gu rgyud du bro brdungs bas/ gzi chen 'bar ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ yid bzhin nam mkha' gang bar 'gyur/ wa swa st+waṃ bha ya st+waṃ ya hāḥ de nas dngos grub blang bani/ oṃ/ mi gnas thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/

rgyal ba kun dang dbyer med par/ sku gsung thugs mnyam sbyor zhing*/ rig 'jin mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ rtsa sngags mthar/ kā ya swa ka tsitta sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐/ bsdu ldang ni/ snang srid lha yi 'or (504)lo kun/ dmigs med yum gyi ngang du thim/ stong nyid bdag med rang rig pas/ dmigs bya dmigs med dran dbang bsgyur/ slar yang sprul pa sgyu ma'i tshul/ sku gsung thugs yon zhing khams las/ gzhan du ma dmigs de nyid yin/ rtsa sngags brjod pas rjes kyi lhar ldang ngo*/ bsngo ba ni/ hoḥ bla med theg pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ rim pa gnyis kyi lam sbyangs bas/ nyon mongs las rnams kun byang ste/ 'phags ma'i go 'phang thob par shog shis brjod ni/ stobs bcu'i dbang phyug rigs lnga'i yum/ rdo rje btsun mo bde ba che/ ye shes lnga ldan rje btsun mas/ rtag tu skyong ba'i bkra shis shog ces dang*/ gzhan yang bkra shis gang rgyas brjod pas bde legs su bya'o/ zhes pa 'di 'ang rig pa 'jin pa'i dbang po bsod nams bstan 'jin gyis snga phyir bskul ba dang*/ nye char tre (505)(506) hor brag sprul rin chen nas kyang gsung bskul btab pa la brten nas zab lam gyi bka' babs 'jin pa 'od gsal rin chen snying po pad ma las 'brel rtsal gyis bod khams spyi'i bstan 'gro'i phan bde gso ba'i cha rkyen du yang dag par dmigs nas legs par spel ba'o/ dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o/// /
